# 1. new keyword API on DataArray (the fix)

# 2. positional still works (back-compat)
r2 = da.integrate('x')
assert np.allclose(r1.values, r2.values); print('da.integrate(\"x\") positional OK')

# 4. old dim= keyword now raises TypeError (consistent with upstream breaking change)

    da.integrate(coord='nope')

# 6. sequence + datetime coord
